name: confirm
doc: An alert with confirm and (optionally) cancel. Superset of ox alertDialog. Drawn by `confirm`. Resolves 'confirm' or 'cancel'.

description.doc: ox `content`. Markdown (bold, italic, code, lists) is rendered.

tone.doc: destructive paints the confirm button with --destructive.

centered.doc: false: sits in the top third (ox default).

cancel.doc: Show a cancel button. Escape always resolves 'cancel'.

timeout.doc: ms until it resolves 'cancel' by itself (reason 'timeout').

meta.doc: Library-specific extras an adapter carries through and a renderer may honour (okok `kind`, mythic `style`, an esx picture…). Never validated.
